mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id as attendanceId, employee_id as employeeId, work_date as workDate, check_in_time as checkInTime, check_out_time as checkOutTime, status as status, tardy_reason as tardyReason, modify_reason as modifyReason FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND work_date = #{workDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) as normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'TARDY' THEN 1 END) as tardyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'EARLY_LEAVE' THEN 1 END) as earlyLeaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 END) as absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' THEN 1 END) as vacationCount FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(work_date, '%Y-%m') = #{targetMonth}

SELECT #{employeeId} as employeeId, #{year} as year, #{month} as month, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as normalWorkDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, check_in_time, check_out_time)/60.0 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalNormalWorkHours, COALESCE(SUM(overtime_hours), 0) as totalOvertimeHours, COALESCE(SUM(night_work_hours), 0) as nightWorkHours, COALESCE(SUM(holiday_work_hours), 0) as holidayWorkHours, 0 as businessTripDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'TARDY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tardyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'EARLY_LEAVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as earlyLeaveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absentDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' AND is_unpaid_leave = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paidLeaveDays, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'VACATION' AND is_unpaid_leave = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unpaidLeaveDays FROM attendance_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND YEAR(work_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(work_date) = #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_record SET status = 'EARLY_LEAVE', modify_reason = 'System Auto Closed' WHERE work_date = #{workDate} AND check_in_time IS NOT NULL AND check_out_time IS NULL
